outcome: Fetal left ventricular modified myocardial performance index (LMPI)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 120 pregnant women, with 60 diagnosed with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) and 60 healthy pregnant women serving as controls.
finding: Fetal LMPI values were significantly higher in the ICP group compared to controls and positively correlated with total bile acid levels, but LMPI values were not associated with adverse neonatal outcomes in ICP cases.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy for fetal cardiac and Doppler measurements, and immediately post-birth for neonatal outcomes.
